value.heading: Report the stories that matter to Kerala
value.intro: We are building a bilingual newsroom that values accuracy, fairness and speed. If you can find a story and tell it well, in Malayalam, English or both, we would like to hear from you.

cards.title: A bilingual newsroom
cards.text: Write in Malayalam, English or both. Stories are edited in the language they are written in.

cards.title: Mentoring and training
cards.text: Learn from experienced editors, with training planned through DTN Academy, our learning platform.

cards.title: Field reporting with modern tools
cards.text: File text, photos and video from your phone into a newsroom system built for reporters on the move.

cards.title: Fair editorial standards
cards.text: We publish our Editorial Policy and work to it: verification, right of reply and open corrections.

cards.title: Reporters
cards.text: Find, verify and write news from your beat or district.

cards.title: Sub-editors
cards.text: Sharpen copy and headlines, check facts and keep our style.

cards.title: Video journalists
cards.text: Shoot, edit and present short news videos and explainers.

cards.title: Social media producers
cards.text: Take our journalism to Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube, accurately.

cards.title: District stringers
cards.text: Report from your own district, freelance, across Kerala.

cards.title: Interns
cards.text: Learn the craft in our newsroom while studying or just after.

value.heading: Open positions
value.empty_text: No openings right now. Send a general application and we will keep it on file.

jobs.title: Senior Reporter
jobs.summary: Demo opening: lead coverage of Ernakulam district, from civic issues to courts, in Malayalam and English.

jobs.title: Video Journalist
jobs.summary: Demo opening: shoot, edit and present short news videos for the site and YouTube.

jobs.title: District Stringers
jobs.summary: Demo opening: report news from your own district as a freelance contributor.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Send the form with your CV and links to your work.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: We read every application and contact shortlisted candidates.

steps.title: Test assignment
steps.text: For reporting, editing and video roles, a short practical task (where relevant).

steps.title: Interview
steps.text: In person or by video call, with the editors you would work with.

steps.title: Offer
steps.text: If it is a match, we send a written offer with the terms.

items.question: How are freelancers and stringers paid?
items.answer: Freelance and stringer terms, including how published work is paid for, are agreed in writing before you start.

items.question: Do you offer internships?
items.answer: Yes, when we have places. Internships are listed under Open positions; you can also send a general application and mention that you are looking for one.

items.question: Which languages do I need?
items.answer: Each opening lists the languages it needs. Many roles need Malayalam; some need English or both.

items.question: Can I work remotely?
items.answer: Each opening says whether it is on-site, hybrid or remote. District stringers usually work from their own district.

items.question: What happens to my CV?
items.answer: Only our administrators can open it, and we delete applications 12 months after they arrive. See our Privacy Policy.

value.heading: General application
value.intro: No opening that fits? Stringers, freelancers and future reporters: tell us about yourself.

seo.title: Careers: jobs in journalism in Kerala
seo.description: Work with Digital Truth News Network: reporters, sub-editors, video journalists, social media producers, district stringers and interns. See open positions and apply online.
